title: UL-18 — Challenge: ECS on Fargate
scenario: Run Fargate task, bump CPU/memory one tier, run again, tear down.
acceptanceCriteria: CPU and memory changed once to next Fargate size tier for pricing comparison.
Second task run uses updated task definition revision.
Public IP only if needed and released after stop.
CloudWatch log group deleted if created.
stopChargesPanel: Delete ECS cluster, TD, logs for ul-18.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-18 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-18 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-18 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-18. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-18) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
